subjects.title: Cultural Activities: Participation in Major Cultural Competitions and Festivals (Purushottam Karandak, Firodia Karandak, Inter-University Youth Festivals, etc.)

units.title: Suggested Activities
units.topics: 1. Registration and participation in a recognised cultural competition. 2. Attendance and rehearsal log for competition preparation. 3. Role-specific responsibility documentation (performer, coordinator, technician, etc.). 4. Research on the history and significance of the chosen competition. 5. Participation in auditions, selections, or eliminations. 6. Group reflection report on teamwork and challenges. 7. Performance review based on jury feedback (if available). 8. Visual/video documentation of rehearsals or performances. 9. Comparative study of two cultural competitions/festivals. 10. Report on institutional representation and learning outcomes. 11. Post-event self-reflection and evaluation (optional).
